title: SkillDAG: Self-Evolving Typed Skill Graphs for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2606.03056v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large skill libraries are now standard equipment for LLM agents, and which subset reaches the prompt decides what the agent can do. Enumeration and top-$K$ embedding retrieval both treat skills as independent documents, assuming relevance is a property of one skill at a time. It is not: skills depend on, conflict with, specialize, and duplicate one another, so the closest match to a task can name it while omitting a prerequisite it needs. Graph retrieval encodes these relations but spends them in a fixed pipeline, handing the agent an opaque bundle. We present SkillDAG, which exposes a typed skill graph to the LLM as an agent-callable interface rather than consuming it for the agent: search returns vector matches, typed-edge neighbors, and conflict signals, and a propose-then-commit protocol lets it register execution-backed edges as it works. Across two benchmarks and three model families, SkillDAG outperforms full-library prompting

translated_title: SkillDAG：面向大规模 LLM 技能选择的自进化类型化技能图
translated_abstract: 大型技能库如今已成为 LLM 智能体的标准配置，而哪些技能子集进入提示词决定了智能体能够做什么。枚举法和 top-K 嵌入检索都将技能视为相互独立的文档，假设相关性是单个技能自身的属性。事实并非如此：技能之间存在依赖、冲突、特化和重复关系，因此与任务最匹配的技能可能只是指出了任务名称，却遗漏了它所需的先决条件。图检索虽然能编码这些关系，但会在固定流程中消耗它们，最终给智能体一个不透明的技能组合。我们提出了 SkillDAG，它将类型化技能图作为可供智能体调用的接口暴露给 LLM，而不是代替智能体去消费它：搜索返回向量匹配结果、类型化边邻居和冲突信号，并且一个“提议-提交”协议使智能体能够在工作过程中注册经执行验证的边。在两个基准测试和三个模型家族上的实验表明，SkillDAG 的表现优于全库提示。
tldr: SkillDAG 将类型化技能图作为可供 LLM 调用的接口，使智能体在技能选择时能感知技能间的依赖与冲突关系，并通过执行验证的“提议-提交”协议实现技能图的自进化扩展。
en_tdlr: SkillDAG exposes a typed skill graph to the LLM as an agent-callable interface, enabling skill selection that accounts for inter-skill dependencies and conflicts, while self-evolving the graph through an execution-backed propose-then-commit protocol.
